meta.protocol: Epistemic Zero Trust — v32.2 Dimension 1; v33.0 internal SPOFs I1/I2
meta.load_bearing_rule: The STATUTE carries the weight; cases corroborate. Never invert this.
notes: Every entry was audited against fabrication markers (wrong senate, weekend dates, hyper-specific narratives, future dates) per the v32.2 inward audit.
Citations below PROBABLE tier are quarantined and NEVER emitted by any document builder.
BGH VI ZR 375/24 (12.05.2026) is load-bearing and was ~10 weeks old at freeze: reverify on the calendar date above. That date is a production obligation, not a comment.
The auto-abo application of section 548 BGB is argued as an analogy chain (Mietvertrag qualification via the provider's own AGB), honestly priced at 0.75 — the O4 gate.

verjaehrung_548.note: Six-month limitation for Vermieter claims from return. The clock is the weapon.
AGB clauses extending the section 548 period are void (section 307 Abs. 1 BGB).

verjaehrung_548.source: BGH; false-fabrication-flag revoked after verification (correction C12)
verjaehrung_548.note: Rueckerhalt of the Mietsache requires a change of possession in the Vermieter's favour (section 548 Abs. 1 S. 2).
Generalklausel: unangemessene Benachteiligung kills AGB limitation extensions.

minderwert_methodology.note: Naturalrestitution; Bereicherungsverbot. New-for-old deduction follows from the statute itself.
Free assessment of evidence — a Gutachten that only sums fictive repair costs does not discharge the opponent's Darlegungslast.
Schaetzung basis — the first coherent number anchors it (judge SPOF J2).

minderwert_methodology.source: Primary source verified (initially suspected fabricated by model audit; false flag revoked, correction C11)
minderwert_methodology.note: Minderwert is regularly NOT the sum of repair costs; Abschlag per age/mileage mandatory; only damage beyond usual Gebrauchsspuren is recoverable.
Changes through vertragsgemaessen Gebrauch are not compensated — the monthly rate fully amortizes ordinary wear.

umsatzsteuer.note: USt only included if actually incurred.
Minderwertausgleich is not a steuerbarer Umsatz — no VAT on fictive amounts.

upe_verbringung.note: NARROWED (correction C8, double-edged): fictive UPE surcharges only where regionally unavoidable in a brand-bound workshop. Requires claimant-specific infrastructure evidence.
Treu und Glauben — no phantom logistics costs the operator never incurs.

abtretungsverbot.source: Gesetz fuer faire Verbrauchervertraege, in force 01.10.2021
abtretungsverbot.note: AGB bans on assigning consumer money claims against the Verwender are absolutely void. Consumer-gated: collapses in B2B.
Legal-Tech Inkasso on Erfolgshonorar basis is a valid Rechtsdienstleistung (section 10 Abs. 1 S. 1 Nr. 1 RDG).

abtretungsverbot.source: Single-source; downgraded per correction C7 (Regelfall wirksam, B2B context)
abtretungsverbot.note: Corroboration only; never load-bearing. Section 308 Nr. 9 carries consumers alone.

sb_atomization.note: Atomizing one einheitlicher Lebenssachverhalt into N independent Selbstbeteiligung positions is treuwidrig.
An AGB clause that functionally empties the paid-for Vollkaskoschutz is an unangemessene Benachteiligung.
Restrictive surprise conditions (report-before-return hotlines) are überraschend.

schufa.note: The SCHUFA defense is statute-anchored, not case-dependent: reporting a bestrittene Forderung is barred by the statute itself (v32.2 repair 1).
Damages — presented as RANGE with citation support, never as arithmetic tariff (self-audit adjoint rule).

schufa.source: BGH; corrected citation (was miscited as 'Juli 2026', correction C5)
schufa.note: Bestrittene Forderungen are no belastbare Bonitätsinformation: Widerruf + Art. 82 exposure. The interlock: a claim computed the way OLG Stuttgart 6 U 84/24 forbids is nicht plausibel dargelegt — reporting it is inadmissible even before dispute.
SCHUFA-Drohung with a contested claim is rechtswidrig.

gebrauchsspuren.note: Burden of proof: the Vermieter must prove each position is übermäßige Abnutzung, not ordinary wear.
Defines Gebrauchsspuren inside the methodology holding (correction C10: individual older AG/LG cites dropped as unnecessary).
